g.text: black: parameter at the fitted thetas; one line per level of a conditioned covariate, other covariates at the pooled centre
this covariate's effect is the SLOPE, a conditioned one's is the GAP between the lines | marginalised source: centre + 10th-90th bar + 2.5th-97.5th whisker
conditioned source (diamond): the single value it was solved at | grey: outside the range any source sampled -- extrapolation
